subject: Remote evidence transfer - SFTP window and SOC 2 sampling
messages:
From: Lina Ortiz <lina.ortiz@novarahealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Remote evidence transfer, SFTP window and SOC 2 sampling

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the call yesterday. We're collecting the log samples and would like to hand off a secure transfer window for the SOC 2 reviewers. High-level ask: can Redwood receive an SFTP drop with a ~7-day retention (read-only) and confirm the sampling window and required file formats?

What we plan to include:
- application logs (json, gz)
- nginx/access logs (gz)
- audit events (csv)

Proposed transfer window: Oct 12–14 (48h availability for the reviewers to pull). If that works, we'll push the artifacts and share credentials.

Attachments: system-logs-sample.tar.gz (preview), SOC2-reqs-mapping.xlsx (mapping of controls -> files)

Questions for you/your security team:
1) Any mandatory filename or directory layout preferences?
2) Will Redwood need a separate account per environment (prod/stage)?
3) Is there a preferred encryption/passphrase approach beyond SFTP (we can PGP the archive if you prefer)?

Tom Hale (cc'd) will be our point for the transfer.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can lock dates.

Thanks,
Lina Ortiz
Head of DevOps | Novara Health
lina.ortiz@novarahealth.com
+1 415-555-0123
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Lina Ortiz <lina.ortiz@novarahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Remote evidence transfer, SFTP window and SOC 2 sampling

Hi Lina —

Thanks for the clear plan. Oct 12–14 works for our SOC reviewers. A few quick notes and requests from our side:

- Directory layout: top-level folder per environment (prod/ stage) is preferred, each with a timestamped subfolder (YYYYMMDD). Example: /prod/20261012/*
- File formats you listed are fine. Please avoid single huge monolithic files; several compressed chunks (~1–5GB each) make parallel downloads easier.
- Separate accounts: yes — please create separate SFTP users for prod vs. stage. Minimum: read-only perms for the reviewer account.
- Encryption: SFTP over keypairs is fine; if you PGP the archives that's acceptable but not required. If you send keys, please use a separate channel (we use Okta Verify / secure-portal for key exchange).

Looping in Ben Carter (security engineer) — he can confirm the reviewer account privileges and advise on any additional metadata we need (e.g., sample manifest). Ben — can you confirm reviewer retention and whether we need an access expiration ticket in your system?

I'll add a calendar placeholder for Oct 12 to remind the review team.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Office: (510) 555-0199

Subject: Re: Remote evidence transfer, SFTP window and SOC 2 sampling

Hi all —

Confirming the technical side. Planned reviewer account behavior:
- Reviewer account: read-only SFTP, no shell access, home directory limited to /reviewer.
- Retention: We'll mirror the drop to an internal staging bucket with a 14-day retention for audits (reviewer-only access). After 14 days we expire the review credentials unless Novara requests an extension.
- Access logs: We'll provide access logs (sftp-session.log) and a transfer manifest with checksums (sha256) for each artifact.

A couple of asks for the upload:
1) Please include a simple CSV manifest at the root of each drop: filename, sha256, compressed_size_bytes, uncompressed_size_bytes, environment, sample_window_start, sample_window_end.
2) If you can separate logs by service (app nginx audit) in the folder structure that will make mapping to controls far easier.

I attached a template for SFTP creds + the manifest example.

Attachments: sftp-credentials-template.txt (attachment)

Let me know if you want me on the call during the transfer window for real-time troubleshooting.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Tom Hale <tom.hale@novarahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Ortiz <lina.ortiz@novarahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T16:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Remote evidence transfer, SFTP window and SOC 2 sampling

Thanks — that sounds good.

We will:
- Create two SFTP users (novara_prod_reviewer, novara_stage_reviewer) and drop the archives into /prod/20261012/ and /stage/20261012/.
- Include the CSV manifest you requested and split artifacts into 2–3GB compressed chunks.
- Share the SFTP endpoint and public key via the secure portal this week.

DocuSign link for the data transfer addendum: https://docusign.net/0-XYZ-9876 (signature required by Oct 11).

Final question: is a single reviewer account per environment acceptable, or do you prefer one per reviewer? We have two reviewers but can either: (A) provide one shared read-only account and rotate passwords after the window, or (B) create separate accounts.

If we don't hear a preference, we will go with option A to keep the handoff simple.

—Tom
Tom Hale
SRE Manager | Novara Health
